interpretation.supported: The fixed East-Asian U->D transition-regime correspondence survives simultaneous removal of simple linear latitude/longitude structure and terminal-edge contribution under the declared CTMC/Brownian reconstruction.
interpretation.synthesis: Across the prespecified test ladder, the signal is strict-coverage robust, directionally insensitive to deletion of any single taxon, not a universal Japan-only rule, not reducible to a simple linear geographic gradient, and not confined to terminal edges.
interpretation.boundary: This remains a present-day niche-based reconstructed branch correspondence. It does not establish observed ancestral environments, historical transition-time climate, selection, adaptation, convergence or mechanism.

stop_rule: No further coarse environmental predictors or post-result public-data robustness variants will be added to rescue or strengthen H1. Further causal resolution requires new focal mediator/fitness or event-linked historical data.
claim_ceiling: This is post-result robustness, not independent confirmation.
Passing jointly rules out only the declared combination of simple linear geography and terminal-edge-only explanation.
Reconstructed internal residual environments are not observed ancestral environments.
No result establishes climate causation, selection, adaptation, convergence, or physiological mechanism.
